title: Window Kind Options Rail
description: Extend UIWindowKindDefinition with declarative options array; render options in a vertical rail on the right inside GoldenLayout windows; cover option kinds in vitest.
summary: Added UIWindowOption discriminated union and options?: UIWindowOption[] on UIWindowKindDefinition. New UIWindowOptionsRail maps all option kinds (section, separator, toggle, select, combobox, button, buttonCycle, input, textarea, checkbox, radio, slider, number, color) into a vertical stack. Window accepts options ReactNode and renders an aside on the right (top-to-bottom). UICanvas wires window kind options into Window. Board play demonstrates options on all three panes. Vitest config now includes index.tsx so embedded tests run; fixed ring tree test expectations to match property-row layout.
